svg.title: Event-Driven Architecture
svg.desc: Event-Driven Architecture. Producers publish events to a broker; any number of consumers react on their own schedule. Step 1, Publish: Order Service publishes an OrderPlaced event to a topic, then moves on without waiting. Step 2, Fan out: The broker delivers a copy to every subscriber; each one reacts independently. Step 3, Backlog builds: A burst arrives. Two consumers keep up, but slow Notifications builds a backlog of its own. Step 4, Scale out: Scale the slow consumer out: three instances share its queue and the backlog drains.

g.text: Order Service publishes an OrderPlaced event to a topic, then moves on without waiting.
The broker delivers a copy to every subscriber; each one reacts independently.
A burst arrives. Two consumers keep up, but slow Notifications builds a backlog of its own.
Scale the slow consumer out: three instances share its queue and the backlog drains.
